plain: The brutalist-demo direction is removed, so a page that sets brand to brutalist-demo loses its square corners and tighter surface padding; switch it to soft-demo or compile your own overlay with brandOverlayCss.

steps.plain: Pages themed with the brutalist-demo brand (data-brand="brutalist-demo") now get the default 8px radius and 24px surface padding, so check them after upgrading and move them to another direction or your own brand overlay.
